record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.context_brief: linear lower bounds for unbounded degree growth
record.original_question: If λ(f)=1 and deg(f^n) is unbounded for a polynomial automorphism of C^d, does there exist C>0 such that deg(f^n)≥Cn for all n?

evidence.quote: Question 40. — Suppose that λ(f) = 1, and deg(fn) is unbounded for some polynomial automorphism f of Cd. Does there exist C > 0 such that deg(fn) ≥ Cn?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d$ be a polynomial automorphism, i.e., a bijective polynomial map whose inverse is also polynomial. For an integer $n\geq 1$, let $\deg(f^n)$ denote the (algebraic) degree of the $n$-th iterate $f^n=f\circ\cdots\circ f$, defined as the maximum of the degrees of its component polynomials. The (first) dynamical degree of $f$ is
$$\lambda(f)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\deg(f^n)^{1/n}.$$
Assume that $\lambda(f)=1$ and that the sequence $\{\deg(f^n)\}_{n\geq 1}$ is unbounded. Prove or disprove: there exists a constant $C>0$ such that
$$\deg(f^n)\geq C\,n\qquad\text{for all }n\geq 1.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question concerning whether unbounded degree growth for polynomial automorphisms of $\mathbb{C}^d$ with dynamical degree 1 must be at least linear. Related literature provides examples of various polynomial degree growth rates and upper bounds for polynomial volume growth in zero-entropy settings, but no source found establishes the conjectured linear lower bound in general. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Degree growth of polynomial automorphisms and birational maps: some examples
status_evidence.snippet: Examples of new degree growths for polynomial automorphisms of C^k and birational maps.
status_evidence.claim: Research provides examples of varied degree growth rates but does not establish a general linear lower bound in the unbounded, λ=1 case.

status_evidence.title: An Upper Bound for Polynomial Volume Growth of Automorphisms of Zero Entropy
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bounds for polynomial volume growth of zero-entropy automorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Related work focuses on upper bounds for zero-entropy dynamics, leaving the linear lower bound question unresolved.
